info.title: Additive approvals v1.3.0 section 6 Option A adapter ONLY
info.description: Normative semantics: approvals-v1.3.0-section6-option-a.md. Does not replace base OpenAPI or authorize implementation.

x-storage.transaction: same BEGIN IMMEDIATE as decision or reviewed ask append; immutable one receipt per cap_hash

x-comparator: hmac.compare_digest over fixed-length decoded MAC bytes

get.description: Read-only; no storage writes, seen/expiry materialization, dispatch or consumption. Live card signs three actions in response memory; consumed card read-only. All query parameters forbidden422. Strict canonical reference decoding. Headers on errors too.

200.description: Authenticated HTML approval card; signatures only in form data, never URL

Set-Cookie.description: __Host-mc-csrf-<cap_hash>=<token>; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; Max-Age <= remaining TTL; no Domain

schema.const: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'

405.description: Only GET; HEAD also rejects, no writes

post.description: No query permitted. Requires exact Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site same-origin and cap-specific host CSRF cookie matching body, both revalidated server-side. Request max65536 UTF-8 bytes, strict JSON. Auth then hash lookup then constant-time MAC/CSRF checks; receipt lookup before unused-cap TTL/lifecycle guard inside atomic transaction. Ask unavailable503 until separately reviewed conversation implementation; never grants or changes pending deadline.

parameters.name: Cookie
parameters.description: Exactly one __Host-mc-csrf-<cap_hash> entry, matching body csrf_token and server derivation

201.description: Reviewed ask append committed, pending retained; no grant

409.description: Authenticated used cap returns existing stored result even after TTL; terminal/stale conflicts do not consume

503.description: feature_unavailable ask or frozen capacity error; atomic zero writes

Reference.name: reference
Reference.description: 32 random bytes, canonical base64url; decode/re-encode exact; no signature or query

OwnerBearer.description: Existing authenticated owner only; no token in URL; reference alone grants nothing

Unauthorized.description: 401 invalid/missing identity, fixed error, no writes

Forbidden.description: 403 owner/scope or authorization_failed MAC/CSRF/Origin, no echo/write

Epoch.description: Strict finite server Unix epoch seconds; no booleans

CapabilityRecord.description: Immutable private record. Cross-field guard: 0<expires_at-issued_at<=300 and expires_at<=approval expiry. No raw/reversible reference or security material.

Result.description: approve=>approved and question_seq null; deny=>denied and null; ask=>pending and committed positive question_seq. Fresh egress policy always applies.
